articles.summary: Prospect Capital Corporation announces pricing of a $300 million institutional offering of 8.95% senior unsecured notes due October 31, 2031.
articles.title: Prospect Capital Corporation Announces Pricing of $300 Million Institutional Offering of 8.95% Unsecured Notes due 2031

articles.summary: Prospect Capital announces an agreement to exit its RGIS investment, with approximately $22 million in expected proceeds and closing expected in November 2026.
articles.title: Prospect Capital Announces RGIS Exit With 13.6% Cash on Cash Realized IRR and 1.6x Multiple of Invested Capital
